definitions.gloss: balcony; outdoor platform attached to a building
definitions.explanation: Typically refers to an uncovered outdoor space projecting from a building.

examples.japanese: バルコニーで{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す。
examples.english: I hang laundry on the balcony.

examples.japanese: バルコニーから{花火|はなび}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: You can see fireworks from the balcony.

examples.japanese: バルコニーに{植木鉢|うえきばち}を{置|お}いている。
examples.english: I keep potted plants on the balcony.

notes:
A loanword from English/Italian "balcony." Refers to an uncovered outdoor platform projecting from an upper floor of a building.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バルコニーに{出|で}る: to go out onto the balcony
- バルコニーで{干|ほ}す: to dry laundry on the balcony
- バルコニー{付|つ}き: with a balcony (in real estate listings)
- バルコニーからの{眺|なが}め: view from the balcony

バルコニー VS ベランダ:
In Japanese real estate, ベランダ typically has a roof/covering, while バルコニー is uncovered. In everyday speech, the two terms are often used interchangeably.

RELATED:
- ベランダ: veranda (covered outdoor space)
- テラス: terrace (ground-level outdoor space)
- {屋上|おくじょう}: rooftop
